name: La Crosse River
gaugeName: LA CROSSE RIVER AT SPARTA, WI
blurb: La Crosse River paddles from Ben Bikin’ Park in Sparta through Amundson Park and Brinkman’s Landing to Rockland. Choose a shorter stretch or the combined Amundson–Rockland trip, with source-backed access areas and dotted course overviews. The longer Sparta–Veterans Park itinerary still has unresolved dam and portage questions.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.difficulty: Not rated; ledges, moving water and woody obstacles
sections.notes: Launch in Sparta below Perch Lake dam and paddle toward Amundson Park. Expect ledges, remnants of the old mill dam and changing wood obstacles. Allow time to inspect obstacles and carry your boat at Amundson; this is not a passive tubing itinerary.

notices.title: Old mill ledges and wood obstacles
notices.text: A firsthand guide describes remaining ledges below South Water Street and reported logjams upstream of Amundson in April 2024. That report is not a current clearance check. Inspect conditions and do not assume a clear channel or an available portage across private land.

sections.notes: A shorter wooded paddle from Amundson Park to the Icarus Road landing. Expect a carry at the park, moving water, a reported ledge and changing woody obstacles. Inspect the takeout while arranging your shuttle.

guideTimes.conditions: Local outfitter’s approximate average for Amundson Park to Rockland boat landing. Conditions, paddling and stops can change the duration. This is published trip guidance, not a live-flow estimate; allow additional time for the shore carry and vehicle shuttle.

sections.notes: Markers identify agency-listed access; the map states whether a landing or an approximate facility area has been reviewed. Mileage is preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry; it is not a surveyed paddling route. This is a long section and may require more than one day; plan daylight, supplies and legal overnight stops. Difficulty has not been independently rated for every section. Check current conditions, hazards and access with the managing agency before paddling.
sections.accessReview: Dam crossing/portage unresolved: Neshonoc, Steensen. A legal, usable route around the barrier has not been established. Do not plan this as a continuous float. A dam lies near a section endpoint (Paper Mill). The landing’s position relative to the barrier still needs confirmation.
sections.routeReview: This section includes Neshonoc, Steensen, Paper Mill and needs a closer check of the landing or portage. Consult the agency guide and signed access; do not assume you can paddle through a dam.
